summary: Alibaba Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting the voting results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting held September 22, 2026. Shareholders approved ordinary resolutions granting the Board a share issuance mandate of up to 10% of issued shares (1,989,248,891 shares) and a share repurchase mandate of up to 10% (1,989,248,891 shares), elected Maggie Wei WU, Kabir MISRA and Weijian SHAN as Group III directors, and approved PricewaterhouseCoopers as U.S. and Hong Kong auditors. Routine AGM results, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisors or structural changes disclosed.
